work.title: What we've made so far
work.intro: Every project starts with a blank garment and a brand with something to say. A few of the collections we designed, mocked up and produced. Client names kept private, on purpose.

industrial.title: Heavy-duty crew line
industrial.story: A complete cold-weather line for a crew that works outside: a large illustrated back print, typographic sleeve prints and matching chest marks across three garments.

northern.title: Arctic-ready workwear
northern.story: Hoodies in four colourways with ice-pattern and gradient fills, matching caps and beanies, and a mug for the office: one visual identity across the whole kit.

residence.title: Team spirit, three ways
residence.story: A burgundy hoodie, black message tees and a two-tone sport jersey for staff teams: one message, three garments, built to be worn every day.

farm.title: Farm crew hoodie
farm.story: A heather-grey pullover hoodie with a chest mark and a bold illustrated back print for the whole farm crew.

team.title: Game-day hoodie
team.story: A two-tone blue pullover with chevron sleeve accents and a full back crest, made to look as good in the stands as on the ice.

art.title: The art behind the brand
art.intro: Before Boldux dressed companies, Boldux was an artist. Stéphane Bolduc, self-taught, draws abstract black-and-white worlds where circles and lines coexist, and turns them into limited-edition clothing and prints.

story.0: Established in July 2023, Boldux Art brings together graphic art, musical composition and design. Stéphane charted his path through theatre, copper work, music, then abstract drawing, and each step shaped a distinct visual identity.
story.1: His inspiration springs from solitude and emptiness. Circles are his favoured form; they appear on paper guided by intuition, and the surrounding emptiness shapes the work until lines and forms coexist in harmony.
story.2: Music, a passion since childhood, runs through everything. It is why the first collection is called Timeless Harmony, and why every garment is meant to be felt as much as seen.

art.quote: Boldux Art is not just a creation; it's a symphony of lines and notes, an exploration of the soul's canvas.

skulls.name: The Skulls
skulls.text: Skulls become canvases for creativity: a curated convergence of the macabre and the mesmerizing, where every circle and line challenges convention. Available as t-shirts, zip hoodies, crewnecks and 26×40 prints.

music.name: Timeless Harmony
music.text: A skull crowned with a clock face and interlocking gears, the word MUSIC carved beneath. A meditation on time, thought and the universal rhythm that connects us all, in five colourways.

warrior.name: The Warrior
warrior.text: Sharp geometric forms, an all-seeing eye and a trailing path of circles: a warrior drawn in a single breath, printed on tees and zip hoodies in five colourways.

aerial.name: Aerial
aerial.text: Wave bands and flame-like strokes inspired by landscapes seen from above: desert, forest, islands, ocean, snow, volcano. Hoodies, tees, windbreakers and joggers filled with terrain.

eye.name: Signature
eye.text: The original Boldux eye and wordmark on zip hoodies, caps, joggers, jackets and tracksuits: the house collection that proves a logo can live anywhere on a garment.

art.printsText: The original drawings, scanned and printed in red, blue, black, white and green. Each series is available in the Boldux Art shop.
art.bridgeText: Every collection above started as a drawing and ended as a garment people wear. That is exactly what we do for your brand: your identity, our creativity, a collection that stands out.
